summary: Phase3 main-runtime remediation remains in progress. Closed families now include alert-rule error contracts, the MCP disabled surface, channel persona consistency, public health disclosure, session-token revocation truth, the TUI route/CLI family, the cross-run memory recall lane, the blind provider-guidance regression guard, the agent-run provider alias/pin lane, the invalid-provider preflight lane, the provider-routing surface drift lane, the workflow graph normalization lane, the missing-rules-bundle fail-closed lane, the shell-executor env-isolation lane, the default-open SSRF lane, and the satellite resume-cursor verification lane. Main runtime now serves authenticated `/v1/status` and `/v1/jobs`, the public `friday tui` command is reachable with dedicated help, PTY reruns show the dashboard rendering against live `/v1/status`, `/v1/jobs`, `/v1/sessions`, and `/v1/satellites/pairing` data, memory-cluster rerun16 shows both main-runtime OpenAI and isolated Anthropic complete teach -> natural recall -> explicit recall -> delete with real memory_search/state evidence, issue-00018 reruns now show provider.update is policy-blocked on an Anthropic runtime before any state change while the current main runtime exposes only the OpenAI provider lane, CAND-20260418-002 reruns now show requestedProviderId/requestedModel aliases are honored end-to-end with explicit pins no longer overridden by learning history, issue-00149 reruns now show unknown providerId is rejected before run creation with 404 PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND, no returned runId, unchanged friday_agent_runs count, and zero persisted invalid-provider rows, issue-00053 reruns now show `/v1/model-routing` plus `/v1/providers/health` are the truthful provider surfaces while legacy `/v1/providers/active` and `/v1/providers/routing` remain absent with 404, the workflow-graph normalization cluster rerun now proves raw `kind/data/from/to` graphs visualize and run successfully while invalid compiled `type:'start'` is rejected at create time with 400 WORKFLOW_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_TYPE, and issue-00070 reruns now show unknown rules bundleIds fail closed with 404 RULES_BUNDLE_NOT_FOUND while a control bundle still evaluates allow and persists normally. Issue-00124 reruns now show missing-skill workflow failures still expose node-level error text, and the residual retry diagnostics gap is closed: `/v1/workflow-runs/:runId/evidence?modules=retry` plus SQLite `workflow_run_retry_traces` both carry `category=logic` with the full NODE_EXECUTION_FAILED message instead of the old unknown/no-message trace. Issue-00133/00134 reruns now show repeated timeout workflow failures bridge cleanly into the public retry surfaces: workflow evidence exposes retry traces plus `pipeline.retry.circuit.opened`, `/v1/retry/traces` returns the final run trace instead of `items:[]`, `/v1/retry/escalations` is non-empty, `/v1/retry/circuit-breakers` shows the open breaker target, and SQLite `retry_traces`/`retry_escalations`/`retry_circuit_breakers` all persist matching rows. ISSUE-00193 reruns now show the Lark webhook lane is no longer an open relay: main runtime still returns CAPABILITY_DISABLED while the standalone live HTTP probe proves webhook mode requires verificationToken, rejects invalid tokens with 403, rejects missing signatures with 401 when encryptKey verification is enabled, rejects bad signatures with 403, and dispatches only correctly signed im.message.receive_v1 events. ISSUE-00103/00164 reruns now show rate limiting is no longer fail-open: default policy coverage includes the missing write-heavy ids, the new coverage test guards route-policy drift, 15 concurrent Anthropic-backed agent runs now split into 10 accepts and 5 HTTP 429s, and SQLite persists matching `agent.run` plus `memory.write` counter rows with truthful rate-limit headers on memory writes. ISSUE-00165 reruns now show transient SQLite write contention is surfaced truthfully instead of as a fake generic 500: under a real BEGIN IMMEDIATE lock, POST /v1/auth/login and POST /v1/secrets both return 503 DEGRADED_MODE with retryable=true plus Retry-After=1, the same lock still allows GET /v1/agent/runs to return 200, and SQLite state confirms no new auth_sessions or secrets rows were persisted under the blocked writes. Release-relevant queued P0/P1 remediation in the current ledger is now exhausted. ISSUE-00187 reruns now show denied marketplace installs land in both audit sinks: a real 403 MARKETPLACE_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED install denial increased SQLite audit_logs from 0 to 3, mirrored listing.installation.denied into friday.db, and appended the same action to the canonical FRIDAY_STATE_DIR/.friday/audit.jsonl file. ISSUE-00158 reruns now show Idempotency-Key is enforced instead of ignored: main runtime replays repeated `/v1/memory/items` and `POST /v1/agent/runs` requests onto a single persisted row per key, while the isolated Anthropic rerun preserves the same one-row replay behavior and records one matching anthropic `llm_usage_records` row for the replayed agent run. ISSUE-00190 reruns now show SSRF is fail-closed by default: the hub config default no longer opts into private-network access, main-runtime and isolated agent runs both report SSRF guard blocks for loopback and metadata URLs, the dedicated loopback probe server recorded 0 hits, and the isolated Anthropic lane still logged usage while denying both private fetches. ISSUE-00199 reruns now show shell skills no longer inherit parent secrets: both runtimes return `visibleEnv=false` for OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, FRIDAY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and FRIDAY_MASTER_KEY while preserving PATH/HOME/TMPDIR, SQLite persists the matching `skill_runs` row, the main OpenAI and isolated Anthropic agent lanes both invoked `skill_run`, and the isolated runtime recorded matching anthropic `llm_usage_records` rows while the probe still reported all secret envs hidden. ISSUE-00205 reruns now show resume cursor verification is still wired through the public satellite sync routes but no longer relies on timing-unsafe string comparison: a real registered-and-approved satellite token hit `/v1/satellites/:satelliteId/sync/push`, a tampered cursor returned `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` and left `hub_settings` without an `ack_checkpoint:*` row, and a control ack on the same route immediately persisted `ack_checkpoint:<satelliteId>:<streamId>` with value `1`. ISSUE-00200 reruns now show node-based skills are no longer exposed as in-process imports on the release runtime: direct POST /v1/skills/:skillId/run against node skill system-health-snapshot returns 501 CAPABILITY_DISABLED, skill_runs row count stays unchanged, and the same disabled policy is enforced in the node executor, agent skill_run gate, and skill-generator explicit test. The isolated runtime reproduced the same fail-closed result and separately proved real Anthropic model participation on the live skill-execution surface via ai-inference returning the exact marker ISSUE-00200-ANTHROPIC-OK. CAND-20260419-013 is now closed: source RCA confirmed the capability-regex false positive on "is blocked or disabled", the isolated rerun no longer short-circuits and instead enters agent started/planning/executing before failing only on invalid Anthropic credentials, and the main-runtime rerun executes the real tool path with tool_start/tool_end plus a truthful CAPABILITY_DISABLED blocker response for the node skill. ISSUE-00170 is now closed on main runtime: the skill-generator explicit self-test no longer auto-passes zero-marker contracts, `/v1/skills/generator/sessions/:id/test` returns BEHAVIOR_TEST_MARKERS_REQUIRED with ok=false executable=false, `/evidence` keeps approvalReadiness.ready=false, `/approve` rejects with 422 VALIDATION_ERROR, and the managed-skills/largest-files-finder directory remains absent before and after the rerun. ISSUE-00176 is now closed on main runtime: strict AppleScript identifier validation now rejects newline-bearing app identifiers before any Darwin actuation path, authenticated `/v1/system/intents` focus and launch_app both return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with the unsafe-app-identifier message, and friday_system_state_journal records failure events without any system.intent.completed row. ISSUE-00056/00084/00129 are now closed on main runtime: heartbeat starts by default unless explicitly disabled, `/v1/heartbeat/status` returns a real lastRunAt/result/interval instead of null/unknown, `/v1/heartbeat/trigger` returns 200 HEARTBEAT_OK, and SQLite friday_heartbeat_state plus friday_heartbeat_runs persist the triggered run. ISSUE-00136/00137/00183 are now closed on main runtime: manual-resolved lesson titles and matched-lesson plan titles are normalized back to `Auto-fixed: retry workflow` / `Auto-fix: retry workflow`, the second same-signature failure creates exactly one new open incident and one planned action, and the third repeat signal keeps the same open incident/action lane flat at incidents=2, openIncidents=1, diagnoses=3, actions=1, plannedActions=1. ISSUE-00146 is now closed on main runtime: authenticated deep-link preview still returns verdict=ready for provider-template imports, but the preview payload redacts providerTemplate.apiKey to `[redacted]` instead of echoing the submitted plaintext secret. ISSUE-00150 is now closed on main runtime: delegated execute tasks no longer downshift explicit `memory_store` instructions into read-only review subagents, past expiresAt hallucinations are ignored, far-future expiry strings remain lexically stable for SQLite expiry comparisons, and fresh rerun f77e9f68-16d4-4fad-a054-f54c00b0c4d9 returned `FOUND ISSUE-00150-MARKER-1776622470250` after storing and searching the plain `agent` namespace. ISSUE-00161 is now closed on main runtime: namespace-only `/v1/memory/prune` no longer deletes live scoped items by default, both dryRun and actual prune left live row 8ebc3b53-b26e-4e25-9842-d7ab3c740ea6 untouched with deletedCount=0, and SQLite still retained that row under `tenant.admin-001.user.admin-001.audit.prune.repro.20260419b`. CAND-20260418-001 is now closed on main runtime: when FRIDAY_STATE_DIR is omitted, the hub audit path now resolves from the initialized runtime stateDir, the bootstrap regression test guards that path selection, and a clean-cwd rerun proved audit_logs plus stateDir `.friday/audit.jsonl` advanced together while the cwd never created its own `.friday/audit.jsonl`. CAND-20260419-004 is now closed on main runtime: the memory learned-facts repro harness deep-redacts accessToken/refreshToken on artifact write, fresh rerun artifacts contain no raw JWT strings, login.json is fully redacted, 21 bearer-authenticated follow-on requests finished with only 200/404 statuses, and authFalseNegative401Count stayed 0 so the phase4 token-redaction false-negative cannot recur through this harness path. ISSUE-00113/00114 are now closed via source plus targeted test verification: audit entries and retention checkpoints persist to `obs_audit_entries` / `obs_retention_checkpoints`, the observability service rehydrates the audit trail from SQLite on startup, and shared queue serialization now keeps concurrent append/retention mutations from forking the hash chain before SHA-256 completes. ISSUE-00154 is now closed via targeted route/integration verification: workflow evidence downloads return raw exported JSON bytes with checksum headers, and both runtime-level and HTTP-level tests now prove the downloaded body sha256 matches the persisted export checksum. ISSUE-00153 is now closed via targeted runtime verification: externally aborted in-flight agent runs now finalize as cancelled instead of failed because the runtime catch path detects aborts and persists the cancelled terminal status. CAND-20260419-005 is now closed via targeted provider-service verification: unpinned OAuth providers without an active login are filtered out before fallback execution, prefetched scoped/OAuth credentials are reused to avoid duplicate tenant-resolution lookups, and the regression test proves a default-provider failure no longer triggers a spurious PROVIDER_AUTH_INVALID attempt on the logged-out Anthropic lane. ISSUE-00086 is now closed via source plus targeted route verification: the learned-facts HTTP surface already includes bulk and per-key DELETE routes behind agent.run scope, the contract snapshot documents both operations, and the route test proves delete wiring is live instead of missing. ISSUE-00074 is now closed via source plus targeted auth verification: discovery inventory routes are gated by desktop.read instead of arbitrary bearer access, policy reads additionally require admin/operator roles, and the new discovery route test locks those scope/role requirements in place. ISSUE-00075 is now closed via source plus targeted auth verification: the learned-facts list/clear/delete routes are all gated by agent.run rather than being scope-free, and the updated uix route test now locks that scope contract in place. ISSUE-00021/00028 are now closed via targeted onboarding verification: `/v1/uix/user-profile` falls back to `friday_setup_state.setup_completed_at` when `user.onboarded_at` is missing, so setup-complete runtimes no longer report `needsSetup=false` with `onboardedAt=null`, and the setup-wizard browser rerun now lands on `/chat` instead of looping back to `/onboarding`. CAND-20260419-003 is now closed via targeted runtime-identity verification: the admin config snapshot now carries the initialized runtimeStateDir plus launchCwd, and focused helper plus isolated-hub coverage prove `/v1/config` reports the live path ownership directly instead of leaving auditors to infer it from port-3141 worktree assumptions. ISSUE-00048 is now closed via targeted CLI verification: `friday run` no longer silently self-hosts over an explicitly configured remote hub, because the CLI now calls remote `/v1/skills/:skillId/run` when both `FRIDAY_HUB_URL` and `FRIDAY_ACCESS_TOKEN` are set, fails fast on half-configured remote env, and only boots an embedded hub when no remote target is configured. ISSUE-00085 is now closed via targeted route verification: Friday now exposes canonical `/v1/learning/*` read routes for incidents, per-incident diagnosis, and overview by aliasing the existing diagnosis handlers, and both the route unit test plus API contract snapshot lock that learning namespace in place. ISSUE-00126 is now closed via targeted observability verification: `friday.agent_loop.runs.total` is now counted once per `loopRunId` instead of depending on `started` arriving first, so terminal-only provider lanes still produce truthful run counters without double-counting the normal started+completed pair. ISSUE-00007 is now closed via targeted runtime verification: explicitly requested file mutations can no longer end as terminal `completed` runs when every file-mutating tool call failed, so blocked writes outside the workspace root now persist truthful failed terminal records instead of misleading success.
